thought: Hard constraints are currently satisfied, but the roster is dominated by pattern-based soft penalties: non_working_days_cost and consecutive_cost are high, with significant weekend overages and some max_total issues (notably Stefaan/Nguyen over max_total and several nurses over max_weekends). Prior block_swap and swap attempts often introduced illegal_succession or increased consecutive_cost, suggesting we need a broader search that can find feasible pattern fixes without breaking succession rules.

strategy.reason: Use a mixed neighborhood to explore both single-day and multi-day pattern changes (swap/reassign/block_swap/block_reassign) to create required consecutive OFF blocks and reduce consecutive-work violations while also allowing workload/weekend redistribution; this is appropriate after repeated non-improving attempts with swap/block_swap alone.
strategy.avoid: Avoid block_swap constructions that tend to trigger illegal_succession and avoid coverage_fill since optimal coverage is not the only driver and adding work risks worsening max_total and weekend overages.
